name: fog-maps
description: Extra map A: each seat is offered only the map views it knows, a wormhole into map A opens its sector, and forbidden views refuse without leaking.

steps.note: you = sol (carrier at 305, alpha wormhole to a000); seat1 = hacan (destroyer at a301, map A's unsectored rest).

steps.label: Sol is offered A / outpost (seen through the wormhole)
Sol may not open map A's rest

expect.ephemeral: That part of the map is not available to you.

steps.label: Hacan opens the core map (home is there)
Hacan is offered map A's rest
Hacan may not open A / outpost yet

expect.ephemeral: That part of the map is not available to you.

steps.label: and is offered it on the new map

steps.note: By hand (images): Sol's core map has a 'Connections to other maps' strip with the a000 wormhole labelled 'A / outpost'; ghost rings with numbers sit on unexplored hexes next to known space; titles read 'Map: core', 'Map: A / outpost', 'Map: A'.
